title: Aquino and Phoenix program psychological warfare in Vietnam

tellings.quote: a psychological warfare operations officer in Vietnam, right? >> The Phoenix program. He was involved in the Phoenix program.

plain: A man named Michael Aquino served as a psychological warfare officer in the Vietnam War and was part of the Phoenix program, a US operation in that war. The writer Peter Levenda says so without naming a source, in a conversation tied to his book The Lovecraft Code. He tells it to place Aquino inside the military's mind-influence work.
